newsitem.title: DENMARK: SOCCER-DRAMATIC WINNER PUTS TENERIFE INTO SEMIFINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DRAMATIC WINNER PUTS TENERIFE INTO SEMIFINALS.

text.p: A goal in the last minute of extra-time from Antonio Mata Olivera gave Spanish club Tenerife a dramatic 2-1 aggregate win over Brondby of Denmark on Tuesday and booked them a place in the semifinals of the UEFA Cup.

Trailing 1-0 from the first leg of this quarter-final, the Spaniards attacked the Danes from the start and levelled the tie when Antonio Pinilla slipped the ball past Brondby goalkeeper Mogens Krogh in the 21st minute.

With the match going into extra-time there were chances at both ends, the best falling to Brondby's Bo Hansen who, with Tenerife goalkeeper Marcelo Ojeda stranded, headed towards goal only to see Julio Gento clear the ball to safety.
Just as it looked as though a penalty shoot-out would be needed to separate the teams, Tenerife made it 2-0 on the night and 2-1 on aggregate.
From a free-kick on the edge of the Brondby penalty area, Mata Olivera struck the ball past the defensive wall and an unsighted Krogh to propel the Spaniards into the last four.
